d:
Cyclone Akwan Alert :chakravati tuphan 'akvan' ka asar jharkhand ke kaee ilakon men dekhne ko mil raha hai. kolhan men mausam ka mijaj achanak badal gaya hai. jamshedpur men der rat se tej havaon aur barish ke karan mausam men badlav dekha gaya. vahin, pakur men tuphan ke badle rukh ka asar mausam par para hai.
Rajdhani ranchi men lagatar ho rahi barish ne kisanon ki chinta barha di hai. kheton men taiyar phaslon par mausam ki mar parne ki aashanka hai. chakravat ke asar se jharkhand ke alag-alag jilon men mausam ka mijaj badal raha hai.
